fact: The Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation in the Office of the President built Kuma, a translation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text and small language model stack for Krio, Temne, Mende and Limba from locally collected data, with prototype outputs in May 2025 and compute access for large-scale training named as a limit.
title: Building language AI for Sierra Leone's indigenous languages (Kuma research)
publisher: Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation (DSTI), Office of the President of Sierra Leone
